title: Search A 2d Matrix
description:
Each row of `matrix` is sorted, and the first value of each row is greater than the last value of the previous row. Return whether `target` occurs in the matrix.

## Examples

```text
Input: matrix = [[1,3,5,7],[10,11,16,20],[23,30,34,60]], target = 3
Output: true
```

```text
Input: matrix = [[1,3,5,7],[10,11,16,20],[23,30,34,60]], target = 13
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= matrix.length, matrix[i].length <= 100`
- Rows are nondecreasing and each row starts after the previous row ends
- `-10^4 <= matrix[i][j], target <= 10^4`
